notes.title: 1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
An update to Exocomets will be released at approximately 17:15 CST on 7/19/2017. Here is the changelog:
[list]
[*]Added a global placement column on the leaderboards
[*]Added colors for each powerup
[*]Added comets on the main menus that the player can bounce around
[*]Added a button in the Options menu to view unlocked powerup descriptions

[*]Changed mouse menu navigation to require clicking

[*]Fix some collision bugs
[/list]
That's all for today. Keep Exocometing!

notes.title: 1.1.2 Update
notes.content:
An update to Exocomets will be released at approximately 15:00 CST on 7/14/2017.  Here is the changelog:

[list]
[*]Made level 3 slightly easier
[*]Made level 4 slightly harder

[*]Added icons for all of the achievements
[*]Added some text to to clarify how navigation works on the scoreboard

[*]Fixed a certain achievement related to star power not unlocking correctly
[*]Fixed a bug where if you pressed escape at the same time that you pressed space, you would have a score of -3
[*]Fixed the player being able to blindly change scoreboards without noticing, causing the effect of loading taking extremely long

[/list]

That's all for today.  Keep Exocometing!
